title: Methodist Church interior early 1900s
description: The interior of the United Church, completed in 1894, reflects a classic Roman church layout. Its 26-by-45-foot floor plan features a west-facing narthex just inside the double doors, leading into the nave. Unusually, the central aisle of the nave slopes downward from the narthex to the chancel, a rare architectural feature in churches of this kind. Ash wainscoting and pews add warmth, while the ceiling is finished in varnished spruce. The church’s prominence is highlighted by a tower above the narthex, crowned with a steeple and belfry.
